beats.care: It shows how a film star's new party is pulling votes, and how the national mood may look before big state elections in 2027.
beats.what: In bypolls counted on 9 October, the BJP won two Bengal seats and Assam's Nagaon. Vijay's TVK won both Tamil Nadu seats.
beats.why: Bypolls fill seats left empty. These were the first votes since the voter-list protests began, so both sides are reading meaning into them.

cards.body: In Assam's Nagaon, BJP's Devasish Sharma beat AIUDF chief Badruddin Ajmal. In Tamil Nadu, TVK, which already runs the state government, won Madurantakam and Dharapuram.

a.body: PM Modi said the mandate gives the party added strength. BJP leaders say voters have rejected the street protests.
a.label: BJP says

b.body: Bypolls usually favour ruling parties. DMK's MK Stalin accused TVK of announcing welfare schemes after the polls were called.
b.label: Opposition says

cards.body: A special election held when a seat becomes empty mid-term, for example when an MLA or MP resigns or dies. Only that one seat votes.
cards.title: what is a bypoll?

opts: Yes, voters are sending a message
cards.q: Do bypolls tell us anything about the national mood?

opts: They were the first votes since the voter-list protests began
cards.q: Why are people reading so much into these bypolls?
cards.why: Coming right during the protests, both the BJP and the opposition see the results as a sign of how voters feel.
